hero.title: Your business is always ready to answer.
hero.description: An intelligent AI secretary that answers your calls, speaks naturally with your customers, manages appointments and helps your business stay available around the clock.
features.title: More than an answering machine
features.intro: Secretary AI can interact with your customers, understand what they need and take action for your business.
features.answers_calls_text: Your AI secretary can answer incoming calls and communicate naturally with your customers.
features.natural_text: Customers can speak normally instead of navigating complicated menus or pressing numbers.
features.appointments_text: Help customers arrange appointments while keeping your business calendar organized.
features.available_text: Your business can have an intelligent first point of contact even outside normal opening hours.
features.intelligence_text: Configure how your secretary communicates and how it should handle different customer requests.
features.custom_text: Customize your secretary's personality, behaviour and business information.
personality.title: Choose your secretary
personality.intro: Every business is different. Choose the personality that best represents your company.
personality.professional_text: A confident and professional personality designed for businesses where clarity and efficiency are important.
personality.friendly_text: A welcoming personality that makes customers feel comfortable and creates a more personal conversation.
personality.energetic_text: An enthusiastic personality for businesses that want a lively and energetic customer experience.
setup.title: Getting started is simple
setup.intro: Set up your AI secretary and let it become part of your business.
setup.account_text: Register your business and enter the information your secretary needs.
setup.configure_text: Choose a personality and configure how your secretary should work.
setup.phone_text: Connect your business phone service and let your AI secretary answer calls.
cta.title: Give your business an AI secretary.
cta.text: Let your customers talk to an intelligent assistant that is available when you need it.
business.title: Business Profile
business.intro: Tell your AI Secretary about your business.
business.basic_text: This information helps your AI Secretary identify and describe your business to callers.
business.name: Business name
business.hours_text: These hours help your AI Secretary determine when your business is open.
register.title: Create your account
register.intro: Set up your Secretary AI account and start building your business assistant.
login.title: Welcome back
login.intro: Log in to manage your AI Secretary.
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Manage your AI Secretary and business settings.
dashboard.business_text: Manage your business name, phone number, opening hours and general information.
dashboard.secretary_text: Choose your secretary's personality and configure how your AI assistant communicates with callers.
dashboard.appointments_text: Configure appointment rules and connect your business calendar.
dashboard.no_activity: No activity yet. Your recent calls and appointments will appear here.
dashboard.status: Your secretary is ready to handle incoming calls.
secretary.title: AI Secretary
secretary.intro: Configure how your AI secretary communicates with your customers.
secretary.personality_text: Choose the communication style your AI secretary should use.
secretary.instructions_text: Tell your AI secretary how you want it to behave when speaking with customers.
secretary.voice_text: Configure how the secretary should interact during calls.
appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.intro: Configure how your AI secretary handles customer appointments.
appointments.calendar_text: Connect your business calendar so your AI secretary can check availability and schedule appointments for your customers.
appointments.settings_text: Define the basic rules your AI secretary should follow when booking appointments.
appointments.advance: How far in advance can customers book?
appointments.availability_text: These settings describe when the AI secretary is allowed to offer appointments.
